Schnittstelle FiniteStateMachine.FiniteStateMachineBuilder<S, IA, OA, B extends FiniteStateMachine.FiniteStateMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA,B>>

Typparameter:
S - the type of states
IA - the type of input symbols (Input Alphabet)
OA - the type of output symbols (Output Alphabet)
B - the concrete builder type for fluent method chaining
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
FiniteStateMachine.MealyMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA>, FiniteStateMachine.MooreMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA>
Umschließende Klasse:
FiniteStateMachine<S,IA,OA>
public static interface FiniteStateMachine.FiniteStateMachineBuilder<S, IA, OA, B extends FiniteStateMachine.FiniteStateMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA,B>>

Generic builder interface for configuring and creating deterministic finite state machines.

This interface uses a self-referential generic parameter B (Curiously Recurring Template Pattern) to preserve fluent method chaining across specialized builder subtypes.

Seit:
1.0.0
